base_pose: standing with wings folded against its back

walk.suffix: , performing a full walk cycle in place: legs and feet cycling through one complete stride, wings kept folded at its sides, body bobbing naturally up and down with each step, classic looping sprite walk animation, no wing flapping, no hovering, no horizontal movement of the body, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: wings slightly folded against sides, front legs mid-stride with one forward and one back, torso leaning slightly forward in walking motion

idle.suffix: , gentle wing flutter, small floating bob, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: wings folded against back, body upright, head tilted slightly, one foot forward in resting position

run.action: running at a brisk gallop in place
run.suffix: , legs cycling quickly through a full running stride, wings folded back against the body, body low and leaning forward and driving, tail streaming behind for balance, energetic looping run animation, no wing flapping, no hovering, no horizontal movement of the body, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: wings folded back, body leaned forward, front limbs extended mid-stride, hind legs pushing off ground, tail streaming behind for balance

sleep.suffix: , chest and belly rising and falling with each slow breath, folded wings settling gently with the rhythm, tail tip twitching occasionally, eyes staying closed throughout, calm looping sleep animation, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: head drooped forward, wings folded tight against body, body relaxed and low, eyes closed

sit.suffix: , settled and still with small head movements, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: perched with wings folded, sitting, tail curled

eat.suffix: , small feeding movements, wings fluttering to hold position, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: head tilted down toward food source, wings partially folded at sides, body leaning forward with front limbs extended downward, mouth open mid-bite

jump.action: surging upward in an excited burst
jump.suffix: , a quick upward wing-burst then settling, one reaction lift, no horizontal movement, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: wings folded back, hind legs coiled beneath body, front limbs extended forward, airborne mid-leap, body angled upward

play.suffix: , lively darting wing flicks, cheerful reaction loop, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: wings fluttering mid-beat, body twisting through the air, limbs relaxed and bouncing, tail curved playfully, head tilted toward a companion

fly.suffix: , wings sweeping up and down in a strong flight cycle, hovering in place, no horizontal movement of the body, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: wings fully extended mid-beat, body tilted forward in flight trajectory, tail trailing behind for balance, limbs tucked or positioned for aerial momentum
